T: Steal through time. Stop for dinner.
D: A boy joins a gang of time-travelling thieves on a wild run through history with a stolen map of holes in time.
P: Serve the main when the boys reach Agamemnon's feast.
S: Whipped feta with honey, olives, vegetables and warm bread

Whipped feta with honey and oregano, marinated olives, cucumber, cherry tomatoes and warm pita, a Greek spread fit for a king. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Spread in a shallow bowl, drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and sprinkle with dried oregano. Cut 1 Lebanese cucumber into batons and halve 250g cherry tomatoes. Warm 4 pita breads, brush with oil and cut into wedges. Arrange everything on a big platter with 150g kalamata olives.
Cheddar, ham, apple, pickled onions and homemade apple chutney

Crusty bread with sharp cheddar, leg ham, crisp apple, pickled onions and a sticky homemade apple and onion chutney. Simmer 1 diced apple, 1 diced onion, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 3 tbsp cider vinegar and a pinch of mixed spice for 20 minutes until thick and sticky, then cool. Slice 1 crusty loaf. Cut 200g vintage cheddar into wedges and 2 apples into slices. Arrange on a board with 150g sliced leg ham, a few pickled onions and the chutney.
M: Winston the ogre's beef and barley stew
Chuck steak, carrot, mushroom and barley stew

A big pot of slow-braised beef with barley, carrots and mushrooms in a rich gravy, served with crusty bread and horseradish butter. Toss 1kg diced chuck steak in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in oil. Add 1 diced onion, 2 carrots, 200g mushrooms and 2 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1.2L beef stock, 100g pearl barley and 2 bay leaves. Simmer covered for 2 hours until the beef is tender. Mash 60g butter with 1 tbsp horseradish cream and serve with a crusty loaf.
W: Tiny flaky custard tarts with caramelised tops and a dusting of cinnamon, small enough to please a general obsessed with little things. Roll 1 sheet puff pastry into a tight log and cut into 12 rounds. Press each into a greased mini muffin tin. Whisk 3 egg yolks, 80g caster sugar, 1 tbsp cornflour, 250ml milk and 1 tsp vanilla in a pan and stir over medium heat until thick. Spoon into the cases. Bake at 230C for 12 to 15 minutes until the tops blister. Cool and dust with cinnamon.
K: Ginger syrup, lemon and soda water over a large ice block

Homemade fresh ginger and lemon syrup topped with soda over a big block of ice, with mint and lemon. Alcohol-free. Simmer 100g caster sugar, 100ml water and a 5cm piece of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Freeze water in a small container to make 4 big ice blocks, or use large ice cubes. Put a block in each glass, add 30ml ginger syrup and the juice of half a lemon, then top with 200ml soda water. Garnish with mint and a lemon wheel.
